versions.changelog: - Split the plugin settings page into two: "TVHeadend Configuration" (settings only) and "TVHeadend Status" (runtime status, active tuners, and the Channels admin actions). The status page's 5-second polling no longer shares a page/DOM with the settings form. Also improved save/load error messages (HTTP status instead of a generic "unknown error") to help diagnose any future failures.

- Fixed a bug where many TVHeadend channels were silently dropped and never reached Jellyfin: the "Channels tagged Other" setting was wired to HTSConnectionHandler before plugin configuration was loaded, so it was always null - any channel whose primary service was tagged "other" threw and got silently skipped. Channels without an assigned LCN (channel number 0/unset) were also unconditionally dropped even though they're valid TVHeadend channels. Channels with no active service (or an unrecognized tag) now also fall through to the "Channels tagged Other" setting instead of being dropped outright.
- Fixed the settings page occasionally failing to save with no feedback and getting stuck on a loading spinner: the configuration load and save requests had no error handling at all, so any failed request (network hiccup, server error) left Dashboard's loading spinner showing forever with no indication anything went wrong.

- "Rebuild channels" now explicitly removes this service's stored LiveTvChannel items that are no longer present on TVHeadend, instead of relying only on Jellyfin's own channel/guide task (which does not reliably remove stale channels on its own). New channels are still picked up via that best-effort task trigger.

- Fixed the "Channels" section's two new buttons breaking the settings page: their click handlers ran unguarded before the form's save handler was registered, so if either button element wasn't found the resulting error stopped the save handler from ever being attached (settings silently failed to save). Also bounded the "Rebuild channels" and "Clear channel logo cache" requests to 45 seconds instead of inheriting a 15-minute background-sync timeout, so a slow or unreachable TVHeadend server can no longer leave the page stuck on a loading spinner.

- Added a "Channels" section to the plugin settings page with two admin actions: "Rebuild channels" (forces a fresh HTSP connection so TVHeadend resends its channel list, then best-effort queues Jellyfin's own Live TV guide/channel refresh task) and "Clear channel logo cache" (force re-downloads all cached channel logos).

- Ported to the Jellyfin 12.0 plugin ABI (net10.0, Jellyfin.Controller 12.0.0-rc4). No source changes were required beyond retargeting, since the underlying MediaBrowser.* assemblies stayed source-compatible.
- Forked and renamed to TvheadEndNew with a distinct plugin GUID so it can be installed alongside the official upstream TVHeadend plugin.
